grammar.title: Even... with 连...都/也
grammar.pattern: 连 + 名词/短语 + 都/也 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 连 (lián) highlights an extreme example, usually paired with 都 or 也 before the verb, to mean "even". It's often used with a negative verb to stress how surprising or extreme something is — for example, "even I don't know".

grammar.title: Any... at all with 任何...都
grammar.pattern: 任何 + 名词 + 都 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 任何 (rènhé) means "any" in the broadest sense — "any at all, no matter which one". It's almost always followed by 都 before the verb to stress that the statement applies without exception.

sentences.zh: 他很努力，因此他成功了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn nǔlì, yīncǐ tā chénggōng le.
sentences.en: He worked hard, therefore he succeeded.

sentences.zh: 他不懂汉语，因此我帮他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù dǒng Hànyǔ, yīncǐ wǒ bāng tā.
sentences.en: He doesn't understand Chinese, so I help him.
